fieldNotes.truckGate: Single wide signalized entrance drive off N Mattis Ave at SW corner. No barrier arm, sliding/swing gate, or pinch-point checkpoint visible in z21 satellite or 2025-08 Street View. Drive is open through a gap in the chain-link perimeter fence; a Walmart monument sign sits at the entrance. Open driveway = no controlled truck gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth structure beside the entrance lane in satellite or Street View.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because there is no truck gate at all.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on two distinct building faces - long south face and the east face - consistent with separate ship/receive operations.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Wide deep paved apron between the road entrance and the dock doors; easily holds 3+ trucks queuing.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Entrance apron is very wide (multi-lane width) with abundant unused paved width to add an express lane.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the south property edge and through the adjacent Kraft Heinz complex, but no spur appears to enter the CJ building itself; marked false with low confidence.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Large dedicated trailer-storage lots full of parked trailers on the south, north, and east sides of the building.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Estimated from perimeter box (~480m N-S x ~510m E-W of usable yard); east trailer yard partly shared with neighbor so figure is approximate.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: South face long bank plus east face bank; ~110 doors estimated from regular bay rhythm across two faces - approximate.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside Champaign IL metro fabric - city streets, residential neighborhoods, and a large industrial cluster surround the site.
